units.source_text: 吟罢取过琴来，弹了美妙的一曲。

en.t: After finishing his recitation, he took up the koto and played a beautiful piece.

units.source_text: 三公主也停止了数念珠，倾听琴声。

en.t: The Third Princess also stopped counting her prayer beads and listened to the sound of the koto.
Just then, the moon came out.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得这团明月，光辉也很凄凉。

en.t: Genji felt that the bright round moon had a radiance that was also deeply forlorn.

units.source_text: 怅望天空，历历回想世间万事变易无常之状，

en.t: Gazing sadly at the sky, he vividly recalled how everything in the world changes and passes away,

units.source_text: 其琴声比平时更加哀怨了。

en.t: and the sound of his koto became even more sorrowful than usual.
